final: SELECT i.store_id, AVG(rental_totals.total_amount) AS avg_payment_total_per_rental, AVG(rental_totals.payment_count) AS avg_payments_per_rental FROM (SELECT r.rental_id, i.store_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total_amount, COUNT(p.payment_id) AS payment_count FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id WHERE p.amount > 4.99 GROUP BY r.rental_id, i.store_id) AS rental_totals GROUP BY i.store_id
